title: Define universal CRM product development 10/10 plan
objective: Turn the existing CRM capability coverage baseline into one binding, sequenced and automation-first product-development plan for a universal modern CRM, including governed triggers, robots, workflows, approvals, pipelines, funnels, Kanban, cadences, omnichannel, service, marketing, customer success, commercial lifecycle, analytics, low-code, AI, marketplace and enterprise proof, without starting Repository Step 15 or changing current product readiness.
deliverables: add PRODUCT_DEVELOPMENT_10_OF_10_PLAN.md as the normative product-portfolio, automation-semantics and functional-completion plan
pre-register Repository Step 23 as Catalog plus effective-dated Pricing and Step 24 as Quote/CPQ approval and process-heavy orchestration so architecture proof cannot select easier domains later
define Phase 8C universal automation with typed triggers, conditions, governed robot actions, durable execution, approvals, visual workflow authoring and sandboxed programmable extensions
define configurable pipelines, funnels, Kanban, sales cadences and guided execution without creating an alternate mutation, authorization, privacy or audit path
sequence later Sales, Service, Marketing, Customer Success, PRM, projects, documents, analytics, integrations, Admin Studio, mobile, AI, marketplace and enterprise product trains
synchronize the implementation roadmap, Phase 8 delivery plan and documentation navigation without changing current readiness or starting Repository Step 15
add permanent documentation tests that prevent omission or weakening of the product waves, automation safety boundaries and 10/10 completion contract
regenerate ACTIVE_PACKET.md from the exact packet declaration
acceptance: the new product plan is normative, sequenced and explicitly covers the complete universal CRM portfolio rather than only backend domain foundations

automation explicitly covers typed triggers, conditions, governed robot actions, durable waits/timers, retries, idempotency, crash recovery, human approvals, visual authoring, simulation, diagnostics and safe programmable extensions
pipelines and Kanban explicitly cover versioned stages, transition rules, required fields/checklists, drag-and-drop validation, saved views, bulk movement, accessibility and performance
Repository Steps 23 and 24 are pre-registered as Catalog/Pricing and Quote/CPQ orchestration respectively and remain architecture validation waves
roadmap, Phase 8 plan, documentation navigation and product plan agree on Phases 8A through 8H and Phases 9 through 11
Repository Step 15 remains the next permitted implementation packet and is not started
Phase 8A and Customer Privacy remain incomplete, architecture 10/10 remains unclaimed, product-level 10/10 remains a future portfolio result and product-complete expert modules remain zero
the exact planning pull-request head passes every applicable permanent workflow on one unchanged meaningful user-authored SHA
non_goals: start Repository Step 15 or any later product implementation
implement workflow runtime, robots, pipelines, Kanban, CPQ, communications, AI or marketplace behavior
change Rust, contracts, schemas, migrations, persistence, routes, workers, manifests, dependencies or product inventory
change Phase 8A, Customer Privacy or module readiness
declare architecture 10/10, product-level 10/10 or any product-complete expert module
add, remove or modify a permanent workflow
